_provenance.note: Assembled by sentinel.core.forex_cycle.assemble_forex over tests/core/saxo_double.SyntheticSaxo. The SHAPE and SIZE are real -- real venue grids, the real feature engine, a real spread profile, and the real renderer draws from it -- and the PRICES are not. It exists so that sentinel.tools.forex_prompt_cost can measure the forex prompt's token profile without a Saxo browser login, because the cost of a call is a fact about the payload rather than about whether its prices are real. Nothing here is evidence about EURUSD.
